كين.note: The morphology assigns كين to استكان, but the classical كين article does not establish a matching general sense. The etymology requires review.

نسو.note: Lisan groups نسوة and نساء under نسا. This noun family is distinct from نسي (to forget); no claim that the two meanings share a single underlying idea is made.

همن.note: Maqayis rejects an independent همن derivation for مهيمن and places it under أمن. The morphology and dictionary analyses differ.

دسو.note: Dictionary spelling/grouping differs from the morphology root; the cited entry explicitly treats this form.
